fingerprints.name: jni

usageContext.scope: cargo direct competing dependency in an app crate; transitive findings require authenticated reachability

fingerprints.tierReason: No recorded published-version qualification for this usage context on both macOS & Windows.

policyNotes: Apps reach the JavaVM, the application Context and Keystore through rightkit-android; app crates do not depend on jni directly for context capture.
App-specific UniFFI exports (model load, PCM sessions) belong in the app's own cdylib; the dependency allowlist decision for uniffi in app crates is made outside this file.
Fingerprints identify review candidates; published two-host replacement qualification is not recorded.
